verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships default AI agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) that users set up on first boot and can invoke to analyze system data — e.g., examining crash dumps to diagnose problems and help report bugs, and offering skills to build apps/themes based on user input. This is agentic assistance tied to system state rather than a dedicated 'insights from your data' analytics feature. missing for 10: evidence of broader data analysis/insights beyond crash diagnostics, no independent hands-on confirmation of the crash-analysis workflow, no detail on what data sources the agent can access or how proactive/scheduled insights work.
